identity.title: Incorrect Current Value Used During Power Range Nuclear Instrument Calibration

cause.proximate_text: The cause of the indication discrepancy was a human performance (HU) error during the performance of MST-I0044 where a 100% current value was used to calibrate span voltage instead of the required 120% current value that should have been used when setting the span setting. ... Technicians failed to use proper human performance tools to ensure excellent outcomes due to complacency from the performer and overconfidence in the performer's proficiency by the peer checker. ... The supervisor exhibited insufficient oversight and engagement because they did not recognize the inherent risks associated with the activity.
cause.theme: human performance error during calibration procedure (complacency, inadequate peer check, insufficient supervisory oversight)

properties.note: Excore nuclear instrumentation; safeguards reactor by monitoring neutron flux and generating trips/alarms

nodes.display_name: Incorrect 100% current value used for span voltage calibration (should have been 120%)
nodes.description: During MST-I0044 performance, technicians used a 100% current value to calibrate NI-41 span voltage instead of the required 120% current value.

nodes.display_name: NI-41 indicating higher flux than other three PRNIs
nodes.description: NI-41 upper and lower flux indicated 63-66% versus 52-55% on NI-42, NI-43, NI-44.

nodes.display_name: NI-41 declared operable without knowledge of prior HU error
nodes.description: NI-41 was declared operable on 10/16/25 following MST-I0044 without recognizing the calibration error had occurred.

nodes.display_name: TS 3.3.1 and TS 3.0.4 noncompliance / NI-41 inoperable condition

properties.note: Station not in compliance with TS 3.3.1 for PRNIs from Mode 2 entry until post-maintenance operability declared; TS 3.0.4 mode change violation also occurred.

nodes.display_name: Partial performance of MST-I0044 to install correct current setting and restore NI-41 accuracy
Procedure revision requests to improve NI calibration procedures and eliminate common error traps
Standing order issued focused on precise control of NIs
Maintenance department stand down highlighting HU tool and verification process lapses
Targeted training to reinforce foundational practices
Technical Specification 3.0.4 (Mode Changes with Inoperable Equipment)

chain: human performance error [cause TBD] -> incorrect 100% current value used instead of 120% for NI-41 span calibration -> NI-41 indicates falsely high flux vs NI-42/43/44 -> NI-41 declared operable without recognizing HU error -> TS 3.3.1/3.0.4 noncompliance (Mode 2 entry 11/1 1534 to operability restored 11/4 0716)
